snippet.title: MAGEROOM V1.0 (( SPOILERS )) FULL GAME SPEEDRUN WORLD RECORD
snippet.description:
I made this game :)
For school, on my own with a cool mentor

Yes this game does not have audio :(
I had a whole thing planned with behind the scenes audio hidden in the game, but the quality was too bad and it was hard to listen to inside the game. Maybe ill hide them somewhere else in the future
For now you can check out how I did the trees on twitter:
https://twitter.com/RealRoryPumpkin/status/1391466520795127812
